smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: Morphome
shortDescription: Turns a floor plan, sketch, or blueprint image into a photorealistic render.
longDescription: Morphome takes a JPG, PNG, or PDF of a floor plan, an architectural sketch, or a blueprint and returns a photorealistic render. You pick a preset for time of day, season, and materials. New accounts get 3 free credits. Dollar amounts for monthly plans load in the app, so see their site for current pricing.
pricingNotes: See their site for current pricing. New accounts get 3 free credits.
bestFor: A photo or scan of a floor plan or blueprint that should become a render
A hand sketch that should become a photoreal exterior or interior
notIdealFor: An editable measured model you correct wall by wall
Virtual staging of an empty listing photo as the only job
strength: Morphome turns a floor plan, sketch, or blueprint image into a photorealistic render without a written prompt.
weakness: The pricing page confirms 3 free credits, and the monthly dollar amounts load after the page opens.

useCaseFit.floor-plan-rendering: Turns a floor plan, sketch, or blueprint image into a photorealistic render.
